subject: Item Shop
text: A set of 7 Mattocks is sold at the Topple Item Shop for 60 GP.

subject: Candy
text: Monsters may leave behind Candy, which can be used to recover some HP.

evidence.quote: While you were fighting, some of the monsters may have left behind a piece of Candy. By using Candy you can recover some of your HP's.

subject: Girl
text: After defeating the monster and talking to the injured Hasim east of Topple, Hasim dies and the Girl joins the party.

evidence.quote: Now go south, and then east one screen. There will be a girl yelling for help! Defeat the monster and talk to the injured man. He tells you to bring the girl to Wendel and to see Bogard. Hmm... this Bogard must be an important man. Hasim, the injured man, will then die. Once he dies the Girl will join your group.

subject: Girl
text: Asking the Girl allows her to recover the hero's HP.

evidence.quote: The Girl has the ability to recover your HP's if you ASK her.

subject: Level Up
text: Gaining EXP leads to leveling up, which allows the player to choose specific attributes to boost.

evidence.quote: As you continue to fight, you will gain exp and eventually a level up. When you level up, you will have the choice to boost certain attributes.

subject: Bogard's house
text: From Topple, Bogard's house is reached by traveling east two screens, south, east, north, west, north, west three screens, north two screens, south along the vines, west, and climbing north up the vine.

evidence.quote: Exit Topple and go east two screens. From here, go south, east, north, west, north, west three times, and north two screens. Then follow the vines around and go south to the next screen. Now go west a screen and climb the vine north to the next screen. Enter Bogard's house.

subject: Bogard
text: Talking to the old man in his house three times reveals his true identity as Bogard.

evidence.quote: Talk to the old man three times, and on the third time he will reveal his identity.

subject: treasure chest
text: Bogard unlocks his back room to the north, where a treasure chest containing a Mattock can be found.

evidence.quote: He then opens the door to his back room. Go north into the room and open the treasure chest for a Mattock.

subject: Mattock
text: To use a Mattock, double-click it on the Item screen, and press the B button during gameplay.

evidence.quote: If you want to use the Mattock, go to the Item screen and double click the Mattock. Whenever you want to use an item, hit the "B" button.

subject: East Cave
text: From Bogard's house, head south, east, north, south on the other side of the mountains, east twice, and climb down the vine into the East Cave.

evidence.quote: From Bogard's house, go south, east, north, south on the other side of the mountains, and east twice. Then climb down the vine and go into the East Cave.

subject: Floor 1
text: On Floor 1 of East Cave, a Mattock is required to clear a path at the southern end of the screen.

evidence.quote: * Floor 1 * Go to the southern end of the screen, and use the Mattock to clear a path. After clearing the path, go south two screens and up the stairs.

subject: house
text: A man in a house east and south of East Cave sells a Battle Axe for 150 gold.

evidence.quote: Now go east twice, south, and east. Go into the little house in the middle of the screen. The man offers to sell a Battle Axe for 150 gold. Buy the Battle Axe and also a Pure Potion.

subject: Swamp Man
text: The Swamp Man cannot be damaged by some weapons, as certain monsters are protected against specific weapon or magic types.

evidence.quote: (As you walked to the building, you may have noticed that you couldn't deal any damage to the Swamp Man. Some monsters are protected against some weapons, so experiment to see which weapons or magic will work on which monsters)

subject: man by the door
text: The man guarding the door at Kett's House states that the eastern room is reserved only for Mr. Lee.

evidence.quote: Talk to the man by the door and he will tell you that "the room to the east is only for Mr. Lee".

subject: Marsh Cave key
text: A person in the north room of Kett's House reveals that the key to Marsh Cave is located in the Lizardmen's nest to the south.

evidence.quote: In the room to the north there are two people. One of them says the key to the Marsh Cave can be found in the Lizardmen's nest to the south.

subject: mirror
text: A resident in the north room of Kett's House reveals that a man discarded a mirror in the Cave of Marsh.

evidence.quote: The other person says that the man threw away a mirror in the Cave of Marsh.

subject: Book of Cure
text: Resting on the beds at Kett's House prompts the Girl to give the hero the Book of Cure, teaching him the Cure spell before she disappears by morning.

evidence.quote: Next, go north and walk onto the unoccupied beds. Just before you go to sleep the Girl will find the Book of Cure and give it to you. The Hero will learn the Cure spell. When you wake up in the morning the Girl is gone.

subject: treasure chest
text: Defeating all the lizards three screens east and one screen south of Kett's House spawns a treasure chest containing the Bronze Key.

evidence.quote: From outside Kett's house, go east three times, and then south. Fight all the lizards. Once they are defeated, a treasure chest will pop up in the middle of the screen. Now open the treasure chest, go to the item screen, and equip the Bronze Key.

subject: monsters
text: Leaving at least one monster alive on a screen before exiting and re-entering replenishes all monsters, allowing rapid gold and experience farming.

evidence.quote: Monsters will also be replenished if there is one or more monsters still alive on the screen. So what you need to do is first, fight all the monsters in a screen, but leave one alive. Then exit the screen and go back in. The monsters will have been replenished. You can do this as many times as you want. This trick will let you gain a huge amount of gold and experience. This trick works especially well in the screen with the Lizard Men.

subject: man
text: A man wandering near the entrance of Marsh Cave Floor 1 joins the group upon speaking to him.

evidence.quote: * Floor 1 * As soon as you enter the cave, you will see a man wandering around on the screen. Talk to him and let him join your group.

subject: Floor 1
text: From Floor 1 of Marsh Cave, walk north, west, and step on the odd tile near the south wall to uncover the stairs leading down to Floor 2.

evidence.quote: Now walk north, west, and then step on the odd tile near the south wall. Then go down the stairs.

subject: Floor 2
text: On Floor 2 of Marsh Cave, travel east, climb down the vine at the log bridge, go west, and re-enter the cave to reach Floor 3.

evidence.quote: * Floor 2 * Go east a screen, and then climb down the vine that is at the end of the log bridge. Now go west a screen, and then go back into the cave.

subject: ice screen
text: On Floor 3 of Marsh Cave, break through the middle of the south wall with a Mattock and slide across the ice to find the Sickle.

evidence.quote: * Floor  3* Now go east one screen. Use a Mattock in the middle of the south wall to make a pathway. Go south a screen and go down across the ice to get the Sickle.

subject: Sickle
text: Equipping the Sickle allows the player to cut down surrounding vines.

evidence.quote: Equip the Sickle and use it to cut down the vines around you.

subject: blobs
text: The blobs on Floor 1 can be defeated with the man's fireballs.

evidence.quote: * Floor 1 * Now go south. (You can kill the blobs with the man's fireballs)

subject: Healing Spring
text: In Marsh Cave, unlocking the north door with a Key, pushing the chest onto the odd tile, and searching the pond downstairs fully restores HP and MP.

evidence.quote: If you want to go to the Healing Spring to restore your HP and MP follow these directions, if you don't just skip over this section and read on. (Use a Key and go north. Then push the treasure chest onto the odd tile and go down the stairs. Go south and search the bottom of the pond. It will heal your HP and MP).

subject: treasure chest
text: Opening the locked east door with a Key and defeating all monsters spawns a chest containing the Iron Shield.

evidence.quote: From the room where you had the option to find the Healing Spring, go west twice, and then north. Use a Key on the east door, and then go through it. Once all the monsters are defeated, a chest will appear. Open the treasure chest for an Iron Shield.

subject: Floor 1
text: Cutting the vines with the Sickle, heading north and east, and breaking the northeast rock with a Mattock reveals stairs to Floor 2.

evidence.quote: Equip the Iron Shield and go west through the door. Use the Sickle to cut down the vines and go north. Then walk east a screen, and use a Mattock on the rock in the northeast corner of the room. Then walk down the stairs to the next floor.

subject: Floor 2
text: On Floor 2, unlock the door with a Key, slide across the northern row of ice, break two rocks with a Mattock, and step on the switch to unlock stairs descending to Floor 3.

evidence.quote: * Floor 2 * Climb along the vines and go south. Then go west and into the cave. Then go west, south, use a Key on the door and go through it. Kill the monsters and slide east on the northern most row of ice. Use a Mattock to break the rock, and then go south and break the southern most rock. Step on the switch, save your game, and equip the Cure spell. Now go down the stairs.

subject: Hydra
text: The Hydra is the boss monster encountered one screen east on Floor 3 of Marsh Cave.

evidence.quote: * Floor 3 * Go east a screen to battle the boss monster of this cave....BOSS Name:          Hydra

subject: Hydra
text: The recommended level for defeating the Hydra is 13.

evidence.quote: BOSS Name:          Hydra...Recommended Level:  13

subject: Hydra
text: Defeating the Hydra awards 94 GP and 10 EXP.

evidence.quote: GP:                 94...EXP gained:         10

subject: Hydra
text: The Sickle is the best equipment against the Hydra, capable of destroying its fireballs while the Iron Shield blocks them.

evidence.quote: Best Equipment:     Sickle...The Iron Shield is able to block any fireballs and your Sickle can destroy any of the fireballs.

subject: Hydra
text: To counter the Hydra, move north as it moves south, attack its heads when it surfaces, and retreat south when it moves towards the top.

evidence.quote: Strategy: To defeat this monster move north as the monster moves south. Then attack the heads as the monster comes up. Once he is moving to the top of the screen go south. Then once the Hydra goes down, move up and attack the heads.

subject: treasure chest
text: Defeating the Hydra yields two chests, the first of which teaches the Fire spell.

evidence.quote: After defeating the Hydra two treasure chests will appear. Open the first one to learn the spell Fire.

subject: treasure chest
text: Destroying the first chest reveals a second chest containing the Mirror.

evidence.quote: Destroy the chest with your weapon and open the second for the Mirror.

subject: Man
text: The Man instructs the hero to show the Mirror to the man at Kett's and disappears as the player warps outside Marsh Cave.

evidence.quote: The Man tells you to show it to the man at Kett's and then the man disappears. You are then warped back outside the cave.

subject: Werewolf
text: Equipping the Mirror and speaking to the guard at Kett's House transforms him into a Werewolf that must be slain.

evidence.quote: * Floor 1 * Equip the Mirror and talk to the man guarding the door. He will turn into a Werewolf.

subject: Face Orbs and Pirates
text: In Kett's Dungeon, Face Orbs and Pirates can only be damaged using Fire magic.

evidence.quote: (In this cave the Face Orbs and Pirates can only be hurt by the Fire magic).

subject: Floor 2
text: On Floor 2, break a pot with a Mattock, step on the odd tile, and take the revealed southeast stairs down to Floor 1.

evidence.quote: * Floor 2 * Go south and use a Mattock on the east wall. Go east through the hole, north, east, south twice, and west. Use a Mattock to break one of the pots, and then step onto the odd tile. Then go down the new stairs in the southeast corner.

subject: chest
text: Unlocking the northern door with a Key on Floor 1 leads to a chest containing the Chain Flail.

evidence.quote: * Floor 1 * Go east, north, and use a Key to open the door. Then go north through the door and open the chest to find a Chain Flail.

subject: Chain Flail
text: The Chain Flail can be used on poles and across chasms or gaps when the Attack Meter is fully charged to pull the hero across.

evidence.quote: Equip the Chain Flail and use it on the east pole to pull yourself across....* Floor 3 * Now go west a screen and use the Chain Flail to pull yourself across the chasm....Kill all the creatures and let your Attack Meter be filled to the MAX. Then use the Chain to go across the gap.

subject: Floor 2
text: On Floor 2, push the treasure chest onto the odd tile to unlock stairs leading down to Floor 1.

evidence.quote: Then, go east twice, north, and west. Push the treasure onto the odd tile, and then go down the stairs.

subject: Floor 1
text: On Floor 1, break the southeast pot with a Mattock to reveal stairs leading down to B-Floor 2.

evidence.quote: * Floor 1 * Now use a Mattock on the southeast pot, and then go down the stairs.

subject: Girl
text: On B-Floor 2 of Kett's Dungeon, unlock the south door with a Key and open the second coffin from right to left on the bottom row to locate the Girl.

evidence.quote: * B-Floor 2 * Go east and use a Key on the door to the south. Go south through the door. Open the second coffin going from right to left, on the bottom row, to find the Girl.
